Start with the reason behind the change.Try this step in the prototype ↗

Resume the project.
Keep its decisions.

The proposed memory system is persistent project knowledge with sources. Updating a memory is separate from changing model weights.

01

Retrieve within the project boundary

A decision belongs to a project and, where relevant, a branch. Retrieval should respect those boundaries before supplying context to a model.

02

Show the source, not just the answer

Inspect the file, section, and revision behind a remembered convention. Correct or supersede a decision when the project changes.

03

Keep useful context under your control

Pin a decision, remove stale knowledge, and export it in a readable form. The prototype lets you search, filter, pin, and inspect sample records.

Design, implementation,
and evidence.

The useful unit of work is a change you can understand and review.

DESIGN

Shape a supported screen

Select a welcome screen, dashboard, or settings screen. Edit its properties and see the preview respond.

  • Registered accent tokens
  • Heading, supporting text, and action
  • Spacing, radius, and example preferences
Edit a dashboard ↗
CODE

Compare with a checkpoint

Save a known configuration, make an edit, and inspect the difference. Copy or download the generated component, tokens, or project JSON.

  • Readable source and change views
  • Undo and redo without losing the project
  • Versioned project import and export
Inspect generated code ↗
CHECKS

Keep the result inspectable

Run named fixture checks. Each explicit run retains its configuration and observed outcome in a downloadable report.

  • Visible pass and fail states
  • Named checks with their limits
  • Session history and evidence export
